text:
The U.S. has long miscalculated due to intelligence failures. Case in point: The war on Iran. Now, an even bigger miscalculation on the Strait of Hormuz. 

Worse than fake news is fake intelligence. Be careful. 

Allah is Great, Greater than ANY power on Earth. In Allah we trust.
translated_text:
美国长期以来因情报失误而失算。典型的例子：对伊朗的战争。现在，霍尔木兹海峡出现了更大的误判。 

比假新闻更糟糕的是假情报。当心。 

安拉是伟大的，比地球上的任何力量都伟大。我们信赖安拉。

text:
Countries like France should stop lecturing the world about “human rights” and international law. The hypocrisy is blatant and embarrassing. 

Your backing of Israel’s genocide in Gaza—and aggression against Iran—has destroyed whatever moral high ground you imagined you had.

像法国这样的国家应该停止向世界宣讲“人权”和国际法。虚伪是明目张胆和令人尴尬的。 

你们对以色列在加沙的种族灭绝以及对伊朗的侵略的支持已经摧毁了你们想象中的任何道德制高点。
